2199.note_text: 1. Principally, a fault is the result of an undesired change of data contained in or flowing through an electronic measuring instrument. 2. From the definition it follows that in this Recommendation, a "fault" is a numerical value which is expressed either in a unit of measurement or as a relative value, for instance in %.

2197.note_text: difference between the error of indication and the intrinsic error of a measuring instrument
